headlines.text: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00% in a 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike; traders still lean toward a December hike after hot inflation data
Wall Street rout deepens as S&P 500 and Nasdaq head for their worst session since June, with the Nasdaq 100 down about 3% on Amazon and Intel's post-earnings AI-spending fallout
Intel shares crash as much as 30%, its worst day since 1974, after Q4 revenue guidance of $15B-$16B missed estimates and flagged a deepening PC slump, dragging Dell, AMD and Nvidia lower too
Amazon shares slide despite AWS revenue surging 39% to a record $46B, as EPS of $1.89 missed estimates and soft Q4 guidance on $220B of 2026 capex spooked investors
Chevron tops Q3 earnings estimates with $9.9B profit as record U.S. production from the Hess acquisition offsets softer crude prices
